narrative.openingSituation: Gaia exists before the sky has taken its place above her.
narrative.centralConflict: The world needs height, horizon, and surrounding waters before divine generations can unfold.
narrative.resolution: Uranus stretches over Gaia, while mountains and Pontus complete the first landscape.
narrative.outcome: Earth and sky are joined, setting up both creation and later oppression.
